ns2:course.label: Physical Activity & Cognition
ns2:course.description: Examines the relationship between physical activity and fitness on brain and cognition across the lifespan. The psychobiology of physical activity effects on cognition is emphasized. Other areas of study include aging, development, and psychosocial factors. Methodological issues as well as human and animal models of research will be studied. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
